data.description:

data.title: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico Secures Ps. 8 Billion in Credit Lines for Debt Refinancing and Airport Investment
data.description:
Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico SAB de CV ( (MX:GAPB) ) just unveiled an update.

Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico has secured bank credit lines totaling Ps. 8,000 million from a consortium of lenders including Santander, BBVA, HSBC, J.P. Morgan and Scotiabank. The short-term facilities, with terms of 6 to 12 months and a floating rate tied to TIIE de Fondeo plus a modest spread, provide near-term liquidity at relatively low cost.

Most of the financing, Ps. 4,258 million, will be used to refinance debt securities maturing in September and October 2026, reducing rollover risk for the company. The remaining Ps. 3,742 million will fund capital investments under its Master Development Program for Mexican airports, supporting ongoing infrastructure expansion and potentially enhancing GAP’s competitive position in the regional airport market.

data.title: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals Posts Interim 1H26 Results and Expands GI Cancer Pipeline
data.description:

On September 11, 2026, Biodexa Pharmaceuticals reported unaudited interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026, highlighting progress across its gastrointestinal cancer pipeline. During the period, the company in-licensed MTX240 for GIST from Otsuka, expanded its Phase 3 Serenta trial of eRapa in Familial Adenomatous Polyposis, and launched a global Early Access Program for eRapa in FAP patients via Tanner Pharma Group.

Operationally, Health Canada approved expansion of the Serenta trial into Canada in June 2026, with 92 of a planned 168 subjects enrolled as of publication, and Fiona Sharp was promoted to CFO and joined the board from January 2026. Post-period, Biodexa raised $3.5 million in gross proceeds through a mix of registered direct, warrant inducement and PIPE offerings, bolstering a cash balance of £3.23 million at June 30, 2026 amid rising R&D spend and continued financing challenges.
